errors.error_description: Assigned a 16-bit add result to an 8-bit signal, causing truncation on the line 'assign narrow = add;'.
Implemented a long, deeply nested conditional (chained ternary) for result selection on the 'assign result_mux = ...' line, creating a long combinational path.
Declared an escaped identifier using a SystemVerilog keyword as a name (wire [7:0] \always), which is legal syntax but poor practice and flagged by lint.
Used logical AND (&&) between vector operands in an if-condition instead of a bitwise operation, potentially causing unintended reduction semantics.
